what_this_is: One captured turn of the external-coding loop run over THIS pack on public FC features: edit the editable predictor -> the fixed public evaluator port re-scores -> compare. It shows the loop is launchable from the pack and that the captured evaluator runs are deterministic under the recorded environment (a score change comes only from a predictor edit, tracked by predict_sha256). See AGENTIC_REPRODUCTION.md.

provenance.evaluator: scripts/run_prediction.py (manifest-pinned public evaluator port; 10-fold CV, seed 42, no confound regression)
provenance.source_boundary: The public evaluator is a port, not the byte-identical original governed harness; see evaluator_source_closure.json.
provenance.editable_surface: scripts/predict.py (the only file the agent may edit)
provenance.terms_dir: Liu FC-pyspi per-term features from OSF 75je2 (the public GitHub release fetched by scripts/fetch_fc_features.py)
reproduce_this_turn: # edit scripts/predict.py PER_COMPONENT_TERMS[0] from 3 terms to ["cov_EmpiricalCovariance"]

baseline.determinism: run_1 == run_2 (identical predict_sha256, identical scores) under the captured public-port environment.
baseline.matches_published: ICA_Cognition 0.183158 equals the recorded value in artifacts/residualised_cheap_check.json

agent_edit_turn.predict_py_edit: PER_COMPONENT_TERMS[0] (ICA_Cognition): [cov_EmpiricalCovariance, dcorr, prec_GraphicalLassoCV] -> [cov_EmpiricalCovariance] (ablate to Liu's single covariance term)

reading: The captured public-port baseline is repeatable (same predict_sha256 -> same scores) and equals the recorded number.

The result is 'not identical' ONLY because the predictor was edited: predict_sha256 changed (380cbb -> 60e83b) and the score moved accordingly. Every predict.py scores identically; the evaluator records which predictor produced each score.

Non-determinism in this captured agentic turn lives in the agent's choice of edits (the search trajectory), while the public evaluator port is held fixed. This supports the loop-discipline demonstration; it is not a source-equivalence claim for the governed harness.
